name: feishu
description: Feishu/Lark bridge for Claude Code — drives Claude in non-interactive streaming mode and relays chat via the bridge (OnIt->Done emoji, streaming cards, tool-approval cards). Configure creds/allowlist via the prompted values (or .env in dev mode).

FEISHU_APP_ID.description: Feishu/Lark Custom App ID (from the Developer Console > Credentials; starts with cli_).

FEISHU_APP_SECRET.description: Feishu/Lark Custom App Secret (from the Developer Console > Credentials).

FEISHU_ALLOWED_OPEN_IDS.description: Comma-separated allowed sender open_ids (recommended; the bot's trust boundary).
